title: The Reduced Council
description: The morning briefing is shorter than it used to be. The people who stayed are here. The ones who left are gone. The question now is what this government does with the nine weeks it still has.

title: Budget Allocation — Reduced Government
description: With a smaller inner circle comes harder decisions about who gets funded. Every ministry that lost a minister this month is about to learn what it costs to be on the wrong side of the arithmetic.

title: Cabinet Loyalty — Personnel Review
description: The betrayals of week 30 have exposed gaps in your government. Some positions need filling. Some people need replacing. Some loyalties need testing before you hand them more power.

title: Tyvaren — Response Window Closing
description: Marshal Vukov's deadline is approaching. The general staff has updated its threat assessment. Dusek says the window for a diplomatic solution is closing. She doesn't say what happens when it closes — she doesn't have to.

title: Aldenmoor — Jonas
description: Jonas hasn't packed yet. He's been sitting in the dark at 11:20pm, waiting for you. He said he wasn't sure you'd come. He said it without accusation — which made it worse.
